div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.nmdp.org/codesystem/donor-status defines the following codes:

tr.td: Donor is available for search, further typing, and collection/transplant (ODS code: AV).
Donor is temporarily unavailable, typically post-collection with a future available date (ODS code: TU).
Donor is currently active on a search — reserved for a specific patient case (ODS code: AC).
Donor has been permanently removed from the registry. Reasons include: not interested, permanently medically deferred, unable to contact, donor too old, or deceased (ODS code: DE).

description.value: Status codes for NMDP registered donors. These codes represent the enterprise Registry Status maintained by NMDP, indicating a donor's availability for patient search, matching, and product request activities. Source: ODS DonorWithSampleResponse (v05).
